name: Laguna Cerro Castillo by the Estero Parada
why: The Torres del Paine of the Carretera Austral: basalt spires and a hanging glacier over a green lake, with a fraction of the people.
book: Since 29 May 2026 CONAF allows this trail only with a certified guide and an authorisation from its regional office. Register at the park administration (Laguna Chiguay, km 57 of Ruta 7) and pay at the ticket booth at the trailhead.
water: The Estero Parada in the forest; nothing above the tree line.
dangers: The last climb to the lake is steep loose scree.
Snow is possible even in summer; the trail closes May to September.
Hantavirus: keep food closed, don't sleep in old huts.
